{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year = 2020–21 |team = Toledo Rockets |sport = Basketball |image = Toledo Rockets wordmark.svg |image_size = 175 |conference = Mid-American Conference |division = West Division |short_conf = MAC |CoachRank = |APRank = |record = 21–9 |conf_record = 15–4 |head_coach = [[Tod Kowalczyk]] |hc_year = 11th |asst_coach1 = Jeff Massey |asst_coach2 = Walter Offutt |asst_coach3 = [[Justin Ingram (basketball)|Justin Ingram]] |stadium = [[Savage Arena]] |champion = MAC regular season champions |tourney = [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result = First Round }} {{2020–21 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Toledo]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Rockets, led by 11th-year head coach [[Tod Kowalczyk]], played their home games at [[Savage Arena]], as members of the West Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the Rockets finished the season 21–9, 15–4 in MAC play to win MAC regular season championship. They defeated [[2020–21 Ball State Cardinals men's basketball team|Ball State]] in the first round of the [[2021 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] before losing to eventual tournament champions [[2020–21 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|Ohio]] in the second round. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they lost to [[2020–21 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]] in the first round.{{Cite web|title=Toledo vs. Richmond - Game Recap - March 17, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311773|access-date=2021-12-02|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Rockets]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 17–15, 8–10 in MAC play to finish in third place in the West division.
